App.Title: SaveHarbor
Header.AppTooltip: SaveHarbor helps you back up, import, restore, and later sync co-op worlds.
Header.StatusTooltip: Latest operation status. This replaces the old bottom status bar.
Header.LatestTooltip: The newest published cloud save version.
Header.GameTooltip: Shows whether the game appears to be running. Save operations are blocked while the game is open.
World.Title: World
World.TitleTooltip: The selected local world SaveHarbor will back up, restore, upload, or replace.
World.OpenFolderTooltip: Open the selected world save folder.
World.RefreshTooltip: Scan the game save folder again and refresh world/backup status.
World.SelectTooltip: Choose which detected world this app should manage.
World.Name: Name
World.PresetTooltip: Secondary world detail (preset or type), when the game provides one.
World.SizeTooltip: Current size of the selected world folder.
World.FilesTooltip: Number of files inside the selected world folder.
World.WorldIdTooltip: Internal world id used as the save folder name.
Backups.Title: Backups & Safety
Backups.FolderTooltip: Click the path to copy the backup folder location.
Backups.OpenTooltip: Open the folder containing SaveHarbor backup zip files.
Backups.LatestTooltip: Latest backup details. Click filename or path to copy it.
Backups.StoredTooltip: Click the stored backup summary to copy it.
Actions.Title: Actions
Actions.TitleTooltip: Commands for local backup/restore/import and cloud synchronization.
Actions.StartGameTooltip: Start a cloud session for the selected world and launch the game. If the cloud save is newer or someone else is playing, launch is blocked.
Actions.LocalFilesTooltip: Local save operations. These work without cloud sync.
Actions.BackupTooltip: Create a zip backup of the selected world. The game must be closed.
Actions.RestoreTooltip: Replace the selected local world from a SaveHarbor backup. A safety backup is created first.
Actions.ImportTooltip: Import a world from a SaveHarbor backup or from a save file from anywhere, such as one a friend sent you. You see what it contains before anything changes, and your current copy is backed up first.
Actions.CloudTooltip: Cloud sync state and actions. Google Drive uses one configured shared folder as the source of truth for everyone.
Actions.SetupCloudTooltip: Paste, test, and save the Google Drive shared folder used by this group.
Actions.ConnectTooltip: Connect SaveHarbor to Google Drive. Sign in once with your own Google account; later starts reuse the saved token.
Actions.CheckTooltip: Check the cloud manifest, latest version, and active session state.
Actions.UploadTooltip: Upload the selected local world to the cloud provider. Upload is blocked if cloud changed while you played.
Actions.DownloadTooltip: Download the latest cloud save. If a local world is selected, SaveHarbor creates a safety backup before restore; if no local world exists, it imports the cloud save into your profile.
Actions.StartSessionTooltip: Mark that you are starting to play from the current cloud version, so friends see an active session warning.
Actions.EndSessionTooltip: Clear your active session lock if you stop playing without uploading.
Activity.Title: Activity
CloudSetup.Title: Google Drive folder setup
CloudSetup.Subtitle: Use one shared folder for your group. Everyone signs in with their own Google account, but reads and writes this same folder.
CloudSetup.FolderLinkTooltip: Paste the Google Drive folder URL or the folder ID from the URL. The folder must be shared with edit access.
CloudSetup.Help: Create a folder in Google Drive, share it with your friends as editors, then paste its folder link here. SaveHarbor stores this once on this PC. Use a separate folder for each game.
CloudSetup.Ready: Paste the shared folder link, then test access.
Dragonwilds.Title: DRAGONWILDS
Dragonwilds.NoWorlds: No worlds found yet. Create a world in Dragonwilds, or download your group's world from the Sharing tab.
Dragonwilds.ChooseWorldHint: Pick a world on the left to see its sharing status and play it.
Dragonwilds.RestoreThisTooltip: Put this backup back in place of the world. The current copy is backed up first.
Dragonwilds.AllWorldInfoTooltip: Everything SaveHarbor can read from this world's save, its files and its backups.
Dragonwilds.NoActivity: Nothing has happened yet in this session.
Dragonwilds.PlayTooltip: Host this world: SaveHarbor gets the group's newest version, marks the world as in use so nobody else hosts it, and starts the game.
Dragonwilds.JoinTooltip: Only starts the game, so you can join a friend who is hosting. Nothing is synced or locked.
Dragonwilds.NoDetails: Details appear here when a world is selected and its save can be read.
Dragonwilds.NoWorldBackups: No backups of this world yet.
Dragonwilds.SettingsTooltip: Your name, save folder, backups and appearance.
Settings.PlayerNameHint: Shown on sessions and shared versions. Leave empty to use your Windows user name. Friends now see:
Settings.ResetTooltip: Use the game's default save folder again.
Settings.BackupFolderTooltip: Open the folder with every backup SaveHarbor made of this game.
Settings.KeepBackupsHint: Older SaveHarbor backups of this game are deleted automatically. The newest backup of every world and recent safety backups are always kept. Your world files are never touched.
Settings.SharedFolderHint: The folder your group uses for this game.
Settings.KeepSharedVersionsHint: Older versions of a world in the shared folder are removed after your uploads. The latest version and any version a session is based on are always kept. On Google Drive, removed versions go to the Drive trash for 30 days.
Settings.AmbientEffectsHint: Slowly drifting embers in the background.
Settings.TroubleshootingHint: Useful when you report a problem.
Inspector.Title: ALL WORLD INFO
Inspector.ShowFileTooltip: Open the save folder with this world's file selected.
Inspector.GameCopyTitle: The game keeps its own backup copy of this world
Inspector.GameCopyHint: If the world is damaged or a save went wrong, you can put this copy back. SaveHarbor shows how it compares and backs up your current copy first.
Inspector.PrivacyNote: The world password and owner ID are never read or shown.
